verdict.rationale: Apple's own stack documents Apple-silicon support. MLX is an Apple ML research array framework built for Apple silicon's unified memory. Apple's developer pages document PyTorch GPU training backends via Metal, plus Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators for machine learning. Evidence for third-party runtimes and for developer access to the Neural Engine is absent, so this covers the vendor-stack path more than broad mainstream-runtime coverage. Missing for 10: llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime support documentation, M4 Max named explicitly in runtime docs, developer-facing Neural Engine (NPU) runtime docs, independent hands-on corroboration of local-AI runtimes on M4 Max.
